pages.title: File:EU plus Pride flag at Budapest Pride 2025.jpg

Categories.value: Taken with Canon PowerShot SX500 IS|Deák Ferenc tér|Self-published work|LGBT pride flags of Hungary|Hungary photographs taken on 2025-06-28|Budapest Pride 2025

ImageDescription.value:
A combination of the European Union flag and the rainbow Pride flag on Budapest Pride 2025, flying in front of some buildings, above a group of attendees of the event and a rainbow umbrella.
The government tried to ban and stop the Pride event from happening, but in 2025 more people turned up than ever.

Artist.value: Banned pride

Categories.value: Taken with Canon PowerShot SX500 IS|Deák Ferenc tér|Patriarchal cross|Self-published work|Hungary photographs taken on 2025-06-28|Budapest Pride 2025|Demonstrations and protests against LGBT events

ImageDescription.value:
A counter-protester at the Budapest Pride 2025 event holding up a two-barred cross, surrounded by press and escorted by event organizers. While taking the picture the man was shouting, in english, "You people are sinners!". The picture was taken before the marching had started on Deák Ferenc square.
The government tried to ban and stop the Pride event from happening, but in 2025 more people turned up than ever.

Artist.value: Banned pride
